extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: A large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain MRI scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources. The dataset includes both clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences, and a wide range of anatomical and pathological variability, including scans with large brain anomalies. Minimal preprocessing was applied to preserve the original image characteristics while reducing barriers to entry for new users.
extraction.creator: Asbjøm Munk; Stefano Cerri; Jakob Ambsdorf; Julia Machnio; Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias; Vardan Nersesjan; Christian Hedeager Krag; Peirong Liu; Pablo Rocamora García; Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi; Mikael Boesen; Michael Eriksen Benros; Juan Eugenio Iglesias; Mads Nielsen
extraction.citeAs: Munk, A., Cerri, S., Ambsdorf, J., Machnio, J., Llambias, S. N., Nersesjan, V., Krag, C. H., Liu, P., Rocamora García, P., Mehdipour Ghazi, M., Boesen, M., Benros, M. E., Iglesias, J. E., & Nielsen, M. A large-scale heterogeneous 3D magnetic resonance brain imaging dataset for self-supervised learning. arXiv:2506.14432v1.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: FOMO60K is aggregated from 16 publicly available datasets containing brain MRI scans. It includes 60,529 scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, spanning both clinical- and research-grade imaging and multiple MRI sequences.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Unknown indicates that scan sequence metadata was not available or could not be reliably identified. In cases where sequence information is unavailable, scans are generically named scan_X.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data are brain MRI scans derived from 16 publicly available datasets: MGH Wild, SOOP, BraTS-GEN, OASIS1, OASIS2, MSD Braintumor, IXI, NIMH, DLBS, IDEAS, ARC, MBSR, UCLA, QTAB, NKI, and AOMIC ID1000.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Subjects have been shuffled to protect privacy and prevent easy identification of dataset sources. Within each MRI session, scans were aligned to the image with the highest spatial resolution. For DWI scans stored in 4D format, if a b=0 volume was available, it was extracted and saved separately. For the b=1000 shell, three diffusion-weighted volumes were selected based on gradient directions most closely aligned with the canonical x, y, and z axes, and the corresponding volumes were averaged to produce a single representative 3D image.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS orientation, affine co-registration, and skull-stripping. All scans were reoriented to RAS and affinely co-registered using the mri_coreg command from FreeSurfer 7.4.1 with default parameters. Skull-stripping was performed using SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1), which outputs segmentation masks of brain structures. These masks were used to define the brain extraction region. Skull-stripping was only applied when the images were not already defaced or skull-stripped by the dataset provider, or when visual inspection identified residual cranial features that could compromise anonymization. The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: FOMO60K is intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale and to facilitate broader adoption of SSL in medical imaging.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Existing source resources are often curated for specific diseases or patient populations, and FOMO60K is aggregated from publicly available sources with heterogeneous protocols. Unknown sequence labels occur when metadata was not available or could not be reliably identified.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale. Accompanying code for self-supervised pretraining and finetuning is provided. The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training.
